name: 19809 · Wilmington, DE
findings: ZIP 19809 (Wilmington) has 1,451 nonprofit organizations. 200 of them (14%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 171 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19809 (Wilmington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19809 (Wilmington) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 14.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 110 organizations here; 74% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
